source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.11 with Fig. 7.12 and Examples 7.10 and 7.11 (PDF 163-167).

blocks.text: Source aur observer (sunne wale) ki relative motion (ek doosre ke nisbat harkat) ki wajah se waves ki frequency (ya pitch) mein jo zahiri (apparent) tabdeeli mehsoos hoti hai, use Doppler Effect kehte hain.

Yeh asar sab se pehle Doppler ne sitaron se aane wali roshni ki frequency dekhte hue note kiya. Kuch sitaron ki roshni ki frequency Zameen par usi qism ke source ki roshni se thori mukhtalif thi. Us ne dekha ke roshni ki frequency ki tabdeeli sitare ki Zameen ke nisbat harkat par depend karti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab naam “John Doppler” likhti hai. Sahi naam Christian Doppler (Christian Andreas Doppler, 1803–1853) hai, jo Austria ke physicist the.

Yeh asar sound waves mein bhi nazar aata hai. Misal: railway platform par khare shakhs ko platform ki taraf aate engine ki seeti ki pitch oonchi lagti hai, aur platform se door jate engine ki seeti ki pitch neechi lagti hai.

Maan lein sound ka source S aaram (rest) mein hai aur wavelength λ ki sound waves nikalta hai. Thehre hue observer ke liye sound ki speed v ho, to observer ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki tadaad, yani frequency f, yeh hai:
Case 1: Source thehre hue observer ki taraf aa raha ho
Jab source velocity uₛ se thehre hue observer C ki taraf chalta hai to waves dab (compress ho) jati hain aur un ki wavelength kam ho jati hai (saath wali Fig. 7.12). Waves itni miqdar se dabti hain:

blocks.alt: Awaz ka source S velocity u_s se daen chalta hai; nuqte us ki lagataar jagahein hain. Us ke chhore gol wavefronts in jagahon par markaz rakhte hain, is liye daen taraf Observer C ki janib ghane aur baen taraf Observer D ki janib phaile hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.12: Source velocity uₛ se thehre observer C ki taraf aur thehre observer D se door chal raha hai. C ko barhi hui aur D ko ghati hui frequency sunai deti hai (kitab ki Figure 7.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har wavefront us jagah se phailta hai jahan source use chhorte waqt tha. Source C ki taraf barhta hai, is liye C ki taraf wavefronts qareeb qareeb hain (chhoti wavelength, oonchi frequency) aur D ki taraf door door (lambi wavelength, neechi frequency). Kitab mein is figure ka number 7.12 dobara chhapa hai; yeh beats wali Fig. 7.12 se alag figure hai.
Waves is liye dabti hain ke utni hi waves ab source ki velocity ki wajah se chhoti jagah mein aa jati hain. Is liye observer C ko yeh wavelength milti hai:
Yahan Δλ ek second mein wavelength ki kami hai; ise Doppler shift kehte hain.
Is liye observer C ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki tadaad (badli hui, yani apparent frequency) yeh hai:
λ_C ki value rakhne par:
Yani observer ko sunai dene wali frequency barh jati hai, aur awaz ki pitch oonchi ho jati hai.
Case 2: Source thehre hue observer se door ja raha ho
Jab source velocity uₛ se thehre hue observer D se door jata hai to waves phail jati hain aur un ki wavelength barh jati hai. Waves itni miqdar se phailti hain:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab phailao ki miqdar ko “λ_D = uₛ/f” likhti hai. Yeh ghalat hai: uₛ/f wavelength ka izafa Δλ (Doppler shift) hai, D ki wavelength nahi; jaise Case 1 mein Δλ = uₛ/f tha. D ki dekhi hui wavelength λ_D = λ + Δλ = (v + uₛ)/f hai. Kitab yahan aur Case 1 mein figure ko “Fig. 7.13 (c)” aur “Fig. 7.13 (d)” kehti hai; asal mein yeh saath chhapi Fig. 7.12 hai (kitab ne 7.12 number do baar diya hai).
Waves is liye phailti hain ke utni hi waves ab zyada faasle mein samati hain. Observer D ko yeh wavelength milti hai:
Yahan Δλ ek second mein wavelength ka izafa hai; ise bhi Doppler shift kehte hain.
Is liye observer D ko ek second mein milne wali waves ki tadaad (apparent frequency):
λ_D = (v + uₛ)/f rakhne par:
Yani observer ko sunai dene wali frequency kam ho jati hai, aur awaz ki pitch neechi ho jati hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: source qareeb aaye to formula ke neeche (v − uₛ), frequency barhti hai; source door jaye to (v + uₛ), frequency ghatti hai.

blocks.caption: Info Corner: sunne ki range (Hearing Ranges)

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Jab hawai jahaz tez hota hai to apne aage hawa ko dhakel kar hawa ke dabao (pressure) ki ek deewar si bana leta hai. Jab woh sound ki speed se aage nikal jata hai to yeh dabao kashti ke peeche bante nishaan (wake) ki tarah peeche reh jata hai aur sonic shockwave banti hai.

blocks.alt: Teen hawai jahaz apne awaz ke wavefronts ke sath. (a) Subsonic speed: gol wavefronts naak se aage rehte hain. (b) Awaz ki speed par: wavefronts naak par jama ho kar charh jate hain (Overlapping). (c) Supersonic speed: wavefronts peeche ek cone ke andar rehte hain jis ke kinare Shockwave hain. Wavefront ke labels dairon ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Do You Know? (PDF page 165): awaz ki speed se kam, barabar aur zyada par jahaz aur shockwave (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab (a) par bhi 'Supersonic speed' likhti hai, magar (a) mein wavefronts jahaz se aage hain, yani jahaz awaz se aahista hai: sahih lafz 'Subsonic speed' hai, jo yahan likha gaya hai. (b) mein jahaz awaz ki speed par hai, wavefronts naak par jama; (c) mein jahaz awaz se tez hai aur wavefronts ka cone shockwave (sonic boom) banata hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.10
blocks.problem: Do trucks P aur Q motorway par ek hi simt mein chal rahe hain. Aage wala truck P 12 m s⁻¹ ki mustaqil speed se hai; peeche wala truck Q 20 m s⁻¹ ki mustaqil speed se chalte hue horn bajata hai, jis ki frequency P ka driver 830 Hz andaza karta hai. Q ka apna driver kaunsi frequency sunta hai? (Sound ki speed = 340 m s⁻¹)
steps: Diya gaya: u_P = 12 m s⁻¹, u_Q = 20 m s⁻¹, v = 340 m s⁻¹, f_P = 830 Hz; f_Q = ?
Q (source) P (listener) ki taraf relative speed se aa raha hai: uₛ = u_Q − u_P = 20 − 12 = 8 m s⁻¹.
Qareeb aate source ka formula: f_P = (v/(v − uₛ)) f_Q. Q ka driver source ke saath chal raha hai, is liye woh asal frequency f_Q sunta hai.

blocks.alt: Daen rukh do trucks: peeche surmai truck Q, Source (20 m s^-1), aur aage neela truck P, Listener (12 m s^-1).
blocks.caption: Example 7.10 (PDF page 166): peeche truck Q source 20 m s⁻¹, aage truck P sunne wala 12 m s⁻¹ (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Example 7.11
blocks.problem: Station se chalne se pehle train horn bajati hai aur platform par khara observer us ki frequency 1200 Hz andaza karta hai. Phir train chal parti hai aur yaksaan (steadily) tez hoti hai. Rawangi ke 50 second baad driver phir horn bajata hai aur platform wala observer frequency 1140 Hz andaza karta hai. 50 s baad train ki speed nikalein, aur 50 s baad train station se kitni door hai? (Sound ki speed = 340 m s⁻¹)
steps: Diya gaya: asal frequency f = 1200 Hz, apparent frequency f′ = 1140 Hz, v = 340 m s⁻¹, t = 50 s; uₛ = ?, S = ?
(i) Train door ja rahi hai: f′ = (v/(v + uₛ)) f, yani 1140 = (340/(340 + uₛ)) × 1200.
(ii) Train aaram se yaksaan tez hui, is liye average speed = (vᵢ + v_f)/2 = (0 + 17.89)/2 = 8.945 m s⁻¹.
blocks.answer: Train ki speed 17.89 m s⁻¹ aur faasla taqreeban 447 m.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne faasla 448 m chhapa hai. Hisab: average speed = (0 + 17.89)/2 = 8.945 m s⁻¹, aur 8.945 × 50 = 447.25 m, yani taqreeban 447 m. Sahi jawab 447 m hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Chamgadar (bats) echolocation se raasta aur khana dhoondte hain: woh oonchi frequency ki awaz nikalte hain aur cheezon se lautne wali goonj (echo) sunte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek train 90 km h⁻¹ par 1000 Hz ki seeti bajati hui station ki taraf aati hai; platform par khara shakhs kaunsi frequency sunta hai, aur usi speed se door jate hue kaunsi (numerical 7.10)? Source observer ke nisbat kaise chale ke frequency na badle (constructed response 7.4)?
blocks.explanation: 90 km h⁻¹ = 25 m s⁻¹ (v = 340 m s⁻¹ lein). Qareeb aate hue: f = (340/(340 − 25)) × 1000 = 1079.4 Hz; door jate hue: f = (340/(340 + 25)) × 1000 = 931.5 Hz. Frequency tab nahi badalti jab source aur observer ko milane wali line ke saath koi relative motion na ho: maslan source observer ke gird daire mein chale, ya dono ek hi velocity se saath chalein (jaise musafir apni hi gaari ka horn sune).

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Doppler effect: source aur observer ki relative motion se frequency (pitch) ki zahiri tabdeeli; aaram mein f = v/λ.
Source qareeb aaye: Δλ = uₛ/f, λ_C = (v − uₛ)/f, f_C = [v/(v − uₛ)] f > f (pitch oonchi).
Source door jaye: λ_D = (v + uₛ)/f, f_D = [v/(v + uₛ)] f < f (pitch neechi).
Example 7.10: f_Q = 810.47 Hz. Example 7.11: uₛ = 17.89 m s⁻¹, S ≈ 447 m (kitab 448 m).
